text:
sarah: Quick follow-up on an ingress signal + resumable-trailer idea. Goal: give SDKs a cheap, non-disruptive hint about queue pressure plus an opt-in trailer for checkpointing long streams.

alex: Two immediate concerns: perf impact of adding a header in hotpath, and tenant privacy on shared clusters.

sarah: Perf: we only do an atomic queue-depth read at dispatch and build a tiny header. Emission is gated by a global flag and per-route visibility. Privacy: header contains numeric fields only, e.g. `X-Edge-Pressure: lvl=2;q=48;win=7` — no tenant ids.

jamie: Define lvl semantics? Clients need to know whether this is advisory or authoritative.

sarah: Proposed mapping: lvl=0 healthy, lvl=1 advisory (suggest batching), lvl=2 constrained (prefer client retry with backoff), lvl=3 shedding (gateway may reject non-priority). SDK guidance: treat lvl=1 as hint and only change behavior at lvl>=2.

mike: Streaming/resume concerns: trailers are awkward across protocols. How do tokens, billing, and replay safety work?

sarah: Trailers are opt-in per-route. When we checkpoint we emit `Edge-Resume` trailer: `Edge-Resume: token=base64url...;offset=1536;lvl=3;exp=300`. Token includes model-version digest, window id, and HMAC. Billing contract: resumed requests are billed only for newly generated tokens after resume; checkpoint metadata kept for short TTL (default 5m). Model rollouts invalidate older tokens. Single-use nonces optional per-route.

alex: Token size and validation: cap tokens ~64 bytes, include checksum and expiry. Provide verification steps for clients.

jamie: Observability: we should avoid tracing explosion. Suggest aggregate histograms (queue depth, admit latency) scraped periodically and sampling traces at admit-time when lvl>=2 or when resume emitted. Dashboards: "Ingress pressure heatmap" and per-route trend lines. Alerting: sustained lvl>=2 for >60s triggers paging.

sarah: Agreed. Sampling at admit-time avoids bias toward long requests. Tag samples with `pressure_lvl` and `admit_bucket`.

mike: Retry storms: many clients will retry on 5xx/429. Can we provide backoff hints?

sarah: Yes: header first as advisory. If we must enforce, return 429 + `Retry-After` and include `Edge-Backoff: base=250;jitter=0.25;mode=exp` as a respectful hint.

alex: Bench plan: microbench hot dispatch with header on vs off (p50/p99, CPU). Also need a tenant opt-out flag for dedicated/private clusters.

sarah: Feature flags: global `edge.pressure_hints.enabled` and per-route `route.pressure.visibility`. Dedicated clusters can set global flag false. I'll add a bench plan to the RFC.

ops-bot: RFC-1450 staged to edge-canary-4 at 02:00 UTC, 10% traffic.

jamie: Action items: sarah will push RFC branch with header schema, trailer token spec, sampling rules, feature flags, and recommended SDK defaults. Alex will run microbench. Mike to review token HMAC and single-use flow. I'll draft dashboard panels and alert thresholds.

sarah: Will do — short spec incoming tonight. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
